chunks: My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: Sa'd bin Abdullah told us, that Ahmad bin Muhammad told us, from Ali bin Hakam, from Saif, from Abdul-A'la bin A'yan, that he said: Abu Abdillah (narrating) from his fathers, peace be upon them, said: The Messenger of Allah, Allah's blessings be upon him and his Family, said:

Indeed, the greatest arrogance is disdaining the creation and stultifying the truth. I said: And what is it to disdain the creation and stultify the truth? He said: That one is ignorant of the truth and vilifies its people. The one who does that, has certainly challenged the Vesture of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He.

key_terms.رِدَاءُ اللَّهِ: The Vesture of Allah, a metaphor for divine attributes or authority
key_terms.سَفَهُ الْحَقِّ: Stultifying the truth, treating it as foolishness
key_terms.غَمْصُ الْخَلْقِ: Disdaining the creation, looking down upon people

ai.seo_question: What is the greatest form of arrogance according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: In *Mani al-Akhbar*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration linking the pinnacle of arrogance to the rejection of truth and the disparagement of its bearers, a state described as contesting with Allah for His 'vesture' (rida'). This metaphor, rooted in Shia exegetical tradition, signifies that the arrogant usurper claims divine prerogatives, effectively stripping God of His honor by asserting independent authority over truth and creation.

en.basel-kadem: 5.	My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, that he said: We were told by Ahmad bin Muhammed, from Ali bin Hakam, from Saif, from Abdul-A’la bin A’yan, that he said: Abu Abdillah said (narrating) from his fathers, peace be upon them: The Messenger of Allah, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, said:

Indeed, the greatest arrogance is disdaining of the creation and stultification of the truth. I said: And what is it to disdain the creation and stultify the truth? He said: That one who is ignorant of the truth and vilifies its people. The one who does that, has certainly challenged the Vesture of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He.
